description: This file implements the DobbyEventListener class and its nested OCIContainerNotification class, which handle container lifecycle events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes, and send corresponding events to a runtime manager.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener
classes.description: Main class that manages container event notifications and communicates with the runtime manager.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification
classes.description: Nested class that handles specific container lifecycle events and triggers corresponding runtime events.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::DobbyEventListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event listener and logs creation.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::~DobbyEventListener
methods.description: Destructor that logs deletion of the instance.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the listener with service, event handler, and OCI container object, and registers for container notifications.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters container notifications and cleans up.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStarted
methods.description: Handles container start event, constructs data, and sends event to runtime manager.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStopped
methods.description: Handles container stop event, constructs data, and sends event to runtime manager.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerFailed
methods.description: Handles container failure event, constructs data with error code, and sends event.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles container state change, maps container state to runtime state, logs info, and sends event.
